messages:
maria.g: quick follow-up on the dashboard aggregation fallthrough we discussed in the RFC — saw a P99 spike when projection miss + authz checks coincided, thinking we need a clearer interface boundary.
tyler.s: saw that in Canary last night too, stacks show authz post-filtering scanning a ton of rows before short-circuit.
ashley: is this where cached tiling returns partial tenant sets and we rehydrate via full aggregation?
samir: yep. pattern: cache miss -> fallback to aggregate query -> authz post-filter (row-level) -> big scan. that kills CPU and latency.
maria.g: tradeoffs: pushdown authz into data layer vs keep central authz but pre-filter with candidate pruning. pushdown is complex for multi-entity RBAC.
julia.k: I sketched an interface: permission_mask(user, tenant_ids) -> bitmap of allowed buckets. then we apply mask before aggregation expands. lightweight and cacheable per user.
tyler.s: mask idea is neat. q: cache keys explode (user x time-window). we could limit caching to long-running service accounts and org admins, and do ephemeral for regular users.
ashley: alternative: best-effort pre-filter using role-sets + tenant-metadata tags, then fallback to row-filter with a cost circuit-breaker if estimated scan > threshold.
samir: we'd also need SLO-safe degrade: if aggregate path would exceed P95 budget, return stale data + a partial_results flag so UIs can surface degragations.
maria.g: ops concern: quota accounting — if we pushdown authz and some tenants route to heavy aggregator, billing needs attribution per tenant not per user. add clear tagging in metrics.
ops-bot: alert: canary-dashboard-agg-01 CPU > 85% (2m ago)
tyler.s: implementation sketch: add QueryPlan.pre_filter(mask_bitset) that accepts a bitset of candidate buckets. keep existing post-filter as fallback; add feature-flag gate.
ashley: I can prototype query-layer change and a mask-generator service behind a flag. will wire into Optimize later for suggestions.
samir: add invalidation hooks for role-change events so mask cache doesn't get poisoned; make invalidation lazy but bounded.
julia.k: tests: fuzz user permission sets, run against replayed production traces, ensure mask cuts scanned rows and doesn't change correctness.
tyler.s: quick pseudo: ```
# pseudo
allowed = permission_mask(user, [t1,t2,t3])  # bitset
plan.pre_filter(allowed)
```
maria.g: ok action items: 1) tyler open mini-RFC PR for QueryPlan.pre_filter, 2) ashley prototype mask generator + feature flag, 3) samir wire role-change invalidation, 4) ops add tenant-tagged metrics and tune alerts. sync next Wed 10:00am. :thumbsup:
